mapper.select: SELECT id, advisor_type, strategy_class, strategy_config, description, status, create_time, update_time FROM ai_advisor_strategy_config WHERE advisor_type = #{advisorType} AND status = 1
SELECT id, advisor_type, strategy_class, strategy_config, description, status, create_time, update_time FROM ai_advisor_strategy_config WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_advisor_strategy_config (advisor_type, strategy_class, strategy_config, description, status) VALUES (#{advisorType}, #{strategyClass}, #{strategyConfig}, #{description}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_advisor_strategy_config SET advisor_type = #{advisorType}, strategy_class = #{strategyClass}, strategy_config = #{strategyConfig}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
